conservative_posthoc_fault_as_loss.classification: Post-hoc conservative fault-as-loss sensitivity, not a clean-run confirmation claim. Original outcomes unchanged.
conservative_posthoc_fault_as_loss.ci_method: Descriptive percentile bootstrap, 50000 resamples of the24seed pairs, fixed analysis RNG20261029; games within each pair stay together. Not48independentgames.
conservative_posthoc_fault_as_loss.interpretation: Both paired directional and score tests can be reported with qualification; the no-runtime-fault criterion was not met. Conservative treatment tests whether the advantage relies on the faulty game.
conservative_posthoc_fault_as_loss.metadata_note: Fault-affected observed_result is copied from the immutable original result, not the sensitivity-recoded result. Raw records were never changed.

rule: Original unification or city-count winner; ties stay in denominator.
selection: v4 fixed before a 16-game development gate; all 16 won. Confirmation seeds were untouched and no source changes or early stopping occurred during confirmation.
statistics: Pair each seed across colors. W=1,D=.5,L=0. Pair sum>1 favorable,<1 unfavorable,=1 neutral. Exact one-sided pair sign and pair-score sign-flip tests; first-attempt alpha .025 for both.
integrity_qualification: One pinned Grok opponent game emitted159 caught KeyError(garrison) exceptions. The preregistered clean-runtime condition failed. Report raw outcomes and post-hoc worst-case sensitivity; do not call this a clean confirmation.
future_attempt_alpha: If another confirmation had been needed, .025/2^(attempt-1); sum over all attempts <=.05. This report contains attempt1 only.
evaluation_host: Unmodified frozen JsonAgent + Environment; host-only compressed full JSONL logging and metrics. Policies ran as separate processes and received official observations only.
reproduction: Use unchanged official tools/play.py commands in README. Minimal public bundle intentionally omits archival research harness and multi-GB observation logs; original manifests, logs, terminal saves and all failures remain preserved in the study archive.
